company.name: Diffuse Bio
company.shortDescription: Diffuse Bio develops an automated AI software platform for drug design, leveraging advances in generative AI.
company.description: Diffuse Bio is developing a fully automated AI software platform for drug design, leveraging advances in generative AI. For the past six years, has been at the forefront of breakthroughs in AI protein design, including the first experimental validation of AI-generated proteins and diffusion models for protein structure and sequence.

productsAndServices.description: A software environment for generating and evaluating AI-designed protein binders, enabling researchers to create candidate sequences for therapeutic and research applications.
productsAndServices.name: DiffuseSandbox

productsAndServices.description: An experimental binder-screening workflow that evaluates large naive or AI-designed protein libraries against selected targets and identifies candidate binders for validation.
productsAndServices.name: RamaX Discovery

productsAndServices.description: An experimental sequence-optimization workflow for improving protein-binder affinity while addressing objectives such as sequence-liability removal, humanization, and cross-species binding.
productsAndServices.name: RamaX Opt

productsAndServices.description: A protein-thermostability measurement method for evaluating the thermal stability of proteins at scale.
